chapters.label: Open the server’s Cron tab — every job, in plain words
Click “+ Add a job” and choose who runs it
Pick a schedule — it is said in words as you type
The command — full paths, and send its output to a log
Add the job — cron checks it before anything changes
Actions → Edit to change it — here, to 02:30
Actions → Delete removes a job; it stops running at once
